notes: checklist IDs originate in goal section 8 governance, not in the RFC.
tests[] entries are placeholders to be replaced by contract authors with
real integration test names; *_contract_tbd marks an unfilled mapping.

requirements.claim: Full RFC and all-branch audit read, source hashes recorded, actual main/source snapshots and drift documented.
Every normative RFC and accepted source contribution has an implementation/test/evidence mapping; experiments, conditionals and provenance-only sources are explicitly classified.
Real subagent launches, assignments, separate ownership, red/green handoffs, and independent reviews are recorded.
Frozen baseline, policy, datasets, native matrix, build settings, and trusted verification mechanism are intact.
Proof-runner corruption/negative-control integration tests reject false greens.
Final evidence references assembled and actual landed clean revisions and rebuilt release binaries, not stale branch results.
Every new requirement has intended red-to-green integration evidence; baseline-correct requirements have mutation/negative-control evidence.

No newly authored unit tests; recovered legacy tests are inventoried, meaningful unit coverage has integration replacements, and any remaining temporary exceptions are minimal and excluded from acceptance.
Existing security/correctness protections were neither deleted nor weakened for performance.
Fixtures and normalized expected graphs are independent of the production discovery/parser implementation.
All/single/multi-target, roots, details, cached queries, resume, invalidation, follow, JSON/JSONL, and reports pass public contract tests.
Metadata-first behavior and old-summary migration are explicit and versioned/profiled; unknown/not-requested/zero remain distinct.
`.git` directories/files, separate Git directories, relative pointers, arbitrary bare names, and HEAD candidate false positives are handled.
Hidden/ignored/nested/build/cache/tmp/package repositories are found under exhaustive policy.
Strict arbitrary placement versus administrative pruning is explicit and tested; finding a repo never silently prunes its working tree.
Native path bytes, case policy, aliases, cycles, root/mount boundaries, and replacement/incarnation are preserved.
Names/types fast path avoids ordinary content reads and unnecessary metadata/path work while handling unknown types/errors.
Early catalog/registry/root candidates improve prioritization without certifying that all independent copies have been found.
Exact validation prevents upward-discovery false repositories.
Independent clones remain distinct; common stores/worktrees/physical aliases are correctly related.
Submodules, broken/missing/locked/prunable/out-of-scope registrations have correct evidence/availability.
Loose/packed/reftable refs, detached/unborn/symbolic HEAD, and SHA-256 pass independent oracles.
Common-ref work is shared; per-worktree HEAD and config evaluation remain separate.
Multiple remotes/roles, normalization, Enterprise configuration, includes/rewrites, and unknown identities are correct and redacted.
Identity-only work excludes unnecessary status/history/object/untracked analysis and uncontrolled subprocesses.
Parent completion and discovered child work/evidence obey crash-safe ordering at every tested commit boundary.
Resume, intermediate huge-directory batches, duplicate discovery, and stale leases/revisions preserve exact results.
Claims/writes are actually batched without disabling synchronization or publication safety.
Barrier-based tests prove real bounded concurrency; recursion remains scheduler-owned.
Byte/item/FD/frontier/alias/queue/helper limits and pressure handling hold under saturation.
Result drainage avoids deadlock; root priorities remain fair; slow/network sources cannot monopolize local progress.
Cooperative cancellation and any helper isolation are honest about blocking syscalls; production cannot activate test failpoints.
Only committed events advance durable follow cursors; report staging/publication/recovery remain atomic and safe.
Existing macOS bulk reader is measured and qualified with retained scope fencing.
Concrete searchfs source handles `.git`/HEAD, continuation/restarts/dedup, path failures, access, and scoped coverage.
Real APFS qualification and promotion/rejection evidence exist; unsupported/unqualified cases fall back honestly.
Native Linux traversal/type handling and inotify new-directory/overflow/downtime behavior pass.
Concrete NTFS baseline enumeration and distinct USN change replay pass native Windows qualification.
Ordinary-permission fallback, reparse points, volume/path identities, and access-denied handling pass without automatic elevation.
Watcher-before-crawl bootstrap and ingested/reconciled cursor separation survive concurrent mutations and crashes.
Event loss/history reset/root change/remount/downtime never creates a false fresh negative.
Dirty-scope coalescing and config/ref/HEAD/registry dependency invalidation do only required work, with justified broad fallback.
Indexed catalog queries return every matching physical copy and valid target-independent inventory is reused.
Cached queries perform no live discovery and distinguish cached/reconciled/incomplete coverage; ordinary files are not catalog rows.
Malicious pointers/config/aliases/commands, oversized metadata, and symlink/rename races cause no outside-scope access or execution.
Discovery/cached paths remain read-only/no-network/no-index-write; explicit fetch passes its separate narrow mutation policy; redaction and failure-to-gap semantics pass.
Correct result graph and equivalent coverage are checked for every accepted measured run.
Cold-application, controlled-cold filesystem, warm scan, cached process/CLI, incremental, and detail modes are truthfully separated.
Required experiments, native comparisons, and worker sweeps have all raw repeated-run results and fixed analysis.
Frozen primary and suite elapsed-time reduction gates pass against B-unified without changing scope, work, inherited optimizations, baseline selection or judge.
Critical nonregression, resource, and mechanical work-budget gates pass on the required native matrix.
Conditional experiments have measured adopted/rejected/not-triggered dispositions; no unsupported stub is counted complete.
No mandatory skip, missing platform, inconclusive confidence bound, invalid bundle, or stale binary is hidden in green.
Independent clean-checkout verification returns zero for the actual landed revision and all required source/implementation IDs.
Documentation, migration guidance, actual benchmark commands, supported capability classes, and evidence index match what shipped.
All kickoff source heads and relevant PRs are enumerated without truncation, pinned and preserved; source/main drift is recorded and reviewed.
Every source commit/component has an independently reviewed contribution disposition; no desired behavior or unique regression protection is silently dropped.
Ancestor, squash-tree and template-blob equivalences are verified correctly; patch IDs alone do not certify behavioral equivalence.
B09 is recovered through B11 and overlapping feature/fetch changes are not applied twice.
B13/B14 alternate variants are compared by actual hunks and tests; branch names and timestamps never substitute for supersession proof.
B15 parentless nonempty tree is compared and its unique useful content recovered without whole-tree replacement or invented ancestry.
B16 base/index/tracked/untracked components are all inventoried; third-parent schema_v7.rs is explicitly recovered or proved identical to its retained replacement.
B17/B19/B20 empty trees and B18 documentary-only delta have verified provenance-only dispositions, not pretend feature merges.
Actual advancing-target merge/conflict evidence is recorded; textual success does not bypass union-of-behavior integration tests.
Every source-side test deletion/weakening has an independently justified replacement; topology, privacy, validation and durability protections survive.
Closure tooling rejects omitted branches, stash components, false equivalences, stale refs and self-authored PASS records through integration negative controls.
No user changes or source refs were destroyed; no force push, blanket ours/theirs, unrelated-history wholesale merge or fake ancestry-only completion occurred.
Catalog producer commit, version and structural fingerprint matrix covers supported v1-v9 and observed same-number variants.
Real historical-layout databases upgrade/query/resume correctly; unknown layouts fail closed without clearing user data.
v7 inventory-ready milestone and v8 atomic durable dedupe survive pruning, abrupt crashes and valid continuation.
v9 remote-name key migration preserves distinct raw bytes and all memberships/refresh rows, with no collisions or missing indexes.
Fresh and upgraded catalogs converge on a canonical tested shape; migration crash/rollback and read-only no-upgrade paths pass.
Executable lifecycle table separates attempt termination from scan-final closure and specifies all valid resume/cleanup transitions.
Legacy and new event/cursor contracts are explicitly versioned/adapted; foreign, corrupt, expired and beyond-tip cursors behave as documented.
Pruned journals never masquerade as a complete replay; prefix check and page read are atomic and read transactions end before slow output/waits.
Progress coalescing preserves cursor-advancing visibility, and duplicate delivery/resume preserves identity idempotence.
Dedupe/backfill remains valid for resumable interrupted/failed states; insufficient legacy retained history fails closed or resets explicitly.
JSONL privacy canaries and ID projection joins pass independently; private report/explicit JSON disclosure is distinguished from path-free event output.
The real opt-in fetch CLI/resume path works; default/metadata discovery has no implicit fetch or network activity.
Refspec and transport/config validation prevent repository-controlled execution and forbidden writes to local heads, HEAD, index or checkout files.
Atomic tracking-ref updates and failed/timed-out/cancelled refresh reconciliation preserve actual observed state without false current labels.
Multiple remotes, custom/negative/excluded/deleted mappings, absent Git and worktree-shared stores pass controlled local-upstream integration fixtures.
Fetch/helper byte/time/process/resource limits and per-phase timing are measured separately from discovery.
Independent Git oracles verify equal/ahead/behind/diverged/no-upstream/missing-upstream/unknown/error comparisons without default-main assumptions.
Shallow, graft/replacement, missing-object and upstream-context cases produce exact counts or honest incomplete history; caches remain bounded.
Requested post-fetch comparisons update only with valid fresh upstream evidence; identity-only paths never perform history traversal.
One hardened streaming pipeline accepts supported legacy/new report versions and union-of-source checks; unknown fields, IDs, groups/totals and diagnostics stay safe.
All actual CLI output lanes work and normalized JSONL/private-report/terminal records agree under the declared projection; parsed-but-refused feature stubs are gone.
Atomic live report, final retention/pruning and publication retry preserve coherent revisions, recovery pins and retained-versus-published truth.
Real PTY and slow/broken-pipe tests prove terminal restoration, no control injection, bounded output and no coordinator starvation.
B-main, predeclared eligible B-source, B-unified and final binary identities/roles are frozen and auditable; baseline selection cannot cherry-pick a slow denominator.
B-unified includes inherited working optimizations; baseline-vs-baseline fails improvement gates and source gains are not mislabeled new.
Every accepted ratio has equivalent graph/coverage/detail/output/durability/resource conditions; new incomparable capabilities use predeclared correct references.
Per-stage and matched-resource measurements distinguish consolidation gains, new optimization, optional enrichment and higher concurrency.
Current generator-owned workflows, templates and build provenance are reconciled without restoring stale or inert CI.
Required proof/native jobs actually execute and feed the trusted fail-closed verdict; mandatory skips/missing artifacts cannot produce green.
Goal-owned reviewed PRs use allowed protected squash integration, Required checks and resolved threads; no protection bypass or source cleanup.
Source/base/head drift is checked before integration; changed trees trigger appropriate conflict and evidence reruns.
Contribution ledger maps to actual landed commits; final release binaries are rebuilt and fully reverified after squash, not inferred from tree equality.
One trusted final verifier reports PASS only when every source and implementation gate is satisfied on the tested landed revision; failures/blockers remain explicit.
